name: app-6ab407985eec81918a3d8dcab22ad23a
description: Middesk helps businesses verify commercial customers, conduct Secretary of State registration searches, and inspect business connections through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Middesk helps businesses verify commercial customers, conduct Secretary of State registration searches, and inspect business connections through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Help me verify a new vendor before we onboard them.
What checks should I run before extending credit to a business?
Show me the businesses in my Middesk account.

positive.description: Search for an existing business entity by name.
positive.prompt: Look up the company Acme Technologies in our Middesk records.
positive.expected_behavior: The app should trigger `list_businesses` and return matching businesses with enough identifying detail for the reviewer to distinguish the correct record.

positive.description: Retrieve detailed profile information for a known business ID.
positive.prompt: Show me the full profile and verification details for business bsn_12345.
positive.expected_behavior: The app should trigger `retrieve_business` and display the business profile, addresses, formation details, status, and review findings for that ID.

positive.description: Search Secretary of State registries for a target business.
positive.prompt: Check Secretary of State filings for Acme Corp in Delaware and California.
positive.expected_behavior: The app should trigger `search_registrations` and return matching state registration records or a task/result that lets the reviewer inspect those filings.

positive.description: Explore connected businesses and shared officers for an existing record.
positive.prompt: Find any connected businesses or shared officers for business bsn_12345.
positive.expected_behavior: The app should trigger `list_connections` and show related businesses ranked by confidence together with the shared people, addresses, or entities linking them.

positive.description: Onboard and verify a new business after explicit user confirmation.
positive.prompt: I confirm placing billable verification orders. Create and verify a new business named Beta Logistics at 100 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
positive.expected_behavior: The app should trigger `create_business`, create the business record, and start the requested verification workflow while returning the created business ID or order status.

negative.description: Do not trigger on consumer credit or personal credit score checks.
negative.prompt: Check my personal Equifax credit score and credit card history.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Middesk supports commercial business verification workflows, not personal credit checks.

negative.description: Do not trigger on general news or open web research.
negative.prompt: What are the latest news headlines about tech startups in New York today?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is a general news search outside Middesk's supported workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger on calendar scheduling or email management.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with Acme Corp on my Google Calendar for 3pm tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is unrelated to business verification and risk assessment.
